source.note: OnTheSnow overview page (read 2026-10-03): 149 runs; 8% beginner, 22% intermediate, 43% advanced, 27% expert; 2,500 acres; 203 acres of snowmaking. Lifts follow Snowbird's own Winter Lift Tickets page (read 2026-10-03): "access to 9 lifts, 2 conveyors and The Tram" (conveyors stored as "other"). OnTheSnow counts 14 lifts (1 tram, 7 high-speed quads, 3 doubles, 3 surface lifts).

features.beginnerArea: Chickadee lift area near the base; Baby Thunder as a next step (confirm)

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Slopeside lodging at the base (e.g. The Cliff Lodge). Snowboarding is allowed, unlike at Alta

character: A large resort in Little Cottonwood Canyon just down-canyon from Alta, opened in 1971 and ticketed separately from it. An aerial tram climbs to Hidden Peak, Mineral Basin lies on the back side, and the terrain leans toward steep, high-alpine skiing; snowboarding is allowed.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain is served by the Chickadee lift near the base area, with Baby Thunder as a common next step; the resort runs its own ski and snowboard school. Confirm current lifts, carpets and lesson products.

Search summary: 2025-26 opening Dec. 7, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 opening-dates list; may show dates revised after weather delays). Closing date was still "TBD" in the closing-date roundup summary.

season.notes: 2026-27: opening day tentatively Nov. 27, 2026 (Snowbird events page; Salt Lake Tribune list). No closing date announced; OnTheSnow's "projected closing date May 09, 2027" is a third-party estimate, not an announcement. As of 2026-10-03 the site says Snowbird is closed for lift-served skiing for the 2025/26 season; scenic Tram rides run to Oct. 11.

prices.note: 2026-27 peak daily ticket per SnowBrains: $238 at the window, $215 online (it calls the online price a "15% discount", though $215 is about 10% below $238). Snowbird's own page lists adult full-day tickets "starting at $195" and up to 15% off the window price when bought online 2+ weeks ahead. TownLift (Sep 4, 2026; CI page saved under Deer Valley) gives Snowbird's 2026-27 peak ticket as $239.

source.note: SnowBrains "How Much Will it Cost to Purchase a 2026-27 Peak Daily Lift Ticket?" (search summaries): Snowbird window $238, online $215. First found 2026-09-30 in a roundup summary (SnowBrains, TownLift, Unofficial Networks). The 2026-10-03 search had $238 in the query, so it is not independent confirmation.

transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Utah applies a winter traction law in the Cottonwood canyons (SR-210 Little Cottonwood) that can require 4WD/AWD or suitable snow tires/chains. Parking rules for 2026-27 are unknown.
